head: 4b3be01e239273cfcc833b81b860c28a086f8727
intent: Wire Reverb live updates end to end between the backend and the browser.

expected.defect: Reverb allowed origins are passed through as full URLs (e.g. REVERB_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://...) while Reverb compares hostnames, so browser connections are rejected.
The production image installs no pcntl PHP extension, so reverb:start dies on startup.
